description: Check whether the Claude account's plan usage is all coming from Claude Code on this machine. Compares the plan meter Claude Code caches (/usage) against this machine's transcripts over time, and checks local signals: account switches, SDK/script use of the login, remote logins, background sessions. Records a plan snapshot on each call; needs a few snapshots over hours to calibrate.

minUnexplainedPct.description: Plan-meter points that must go unexplained before an interval is flagged (default 3)

name: detect_foreign_usage
